details: Ripple has received final approval from the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC) to establish Ripple National Trust Bank (RNTB). This federal charter strengthens Ripple's regulatory foundation, allowing RNTB to manage reserves supporting Ripple USD (RLUSD), act as collateral trustee for RLUSD holders, and provide fiduciary digital asset custody services. This move reinforces Ripple's commitment to building digital asset infrastructure within the regulated financial system.
title: Ripple Secures Final OCC Approval for National Trust Bank

details: Chainlink has introduced CustodySync in partnership with Anchorage Digital Bank, enabling institutional clients to access decentralized finance (DeFi) lending markets using assets held in qualified custody. This solution addresses a critical barrier by allowing institutions to borrow against custodied assets without directly transferring them to DeFi protocols, leveraging Chainlink's data oracles for synchronized valuations and collateral management.
title: Chainlink Launches CustodySync with Anchorage for Institutional DeFi Borrowing

details: A recent University of Michigan study indicates that Americans' long-run inflation expectations remain elevated, potentially complicating efforts for easier financing conditions for Bitcoin. This persistent inflation outlook could weigh on Bitcoin, especially as the cryptocurrency has shown sensitivity to inflation figures impacting interest-rate expectations.
title: Bitcoin Faces Inflation Warning as US Consumer Sentiment Remains Steady

details: The highly anticipated "Glamsterdam" upgrade for Ethereum has been postponed on a major testnet after security firm ChainSecurity identified 13 potential security risks affecting existing smart contracts. Developers agreed to investigate how proposed changes to Ethereum's gas-accounting system could impact applications, leading to the cancellation of a crucial testnet activation originally scheduled for October 26th.
title: Ethereum's Glamsterdam Upgrade Delayed Due to Security Risks

details: Ripple has launched new features for its Ripple Treasury platform, incorporating AI-powered automation and a "24/7 Returns" program for eligible corporate clients. This service allows businesses to earn returns on qualifying digital assets, including the RLUSD stablecoin, and manage cash flow around the clock, aiming to bridge traditional finance with digital asset capabilities.
title: Ripple Treasury Integrates AI for 24/7 Corporate Cash Management with RLUSD

details: After two weeks of net outflows, Bitcoin Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) have experienced a significant turnaround, recording $301 million in net inflows. This rebound indicates renewed institutional and retail investor interest in Bitcoin spot ETFs following a period of withdrawal.
title: Bitcoin ETFs Break Two-Week Outflow Streak with $301M Influx

details: Bernstein has reduced its price target for Coinbase to $250 from $330, citing weaker crypto trading volumes and a stalled recovery in the market. The analysts also cut their 2026 revenue forecast for the crypto exchange, reflecting concerns about the impact of current market conditions on trading activity.
title: Bernstein Lowers Coinbase Target Amid Weak Trading Volumes
